summary: Iteration 2 focused on the two new features: Multi Identità (multiple fiscal profiles per user) and Wallet Pass (Apple .pkpass + Google Wallet save link). Backend: 23/23 NEW pytest tests PASSED (create first profile auto-default; second is_default=false; validation 422; list/get/put/set-default/soft-delete; ownership isolation 404 for other user's id and for invalid ObjectId; shares with fiscal_profile_id returns profile_id + profile_label; empty body uses default; unowned id → 404; public share has NO leak of _id/user_id/label/is_default; wallet-tokens returns apple_url+google_url+note; Apple pkpass is a valid ZIP with pass.json/manifest.json/signature/icon.png/icon@2x.png/logo.png/logo@2x.png and pass.json has formatVersion=1 and passTypeIdentifier; invalid apple jwt → 404; Google returns 302 to https://pay.google.com/gp/v/save/... with invalid → 404; legacy singular POST /fiscal-profile still upserts; legacy GET /fiscal-profile returns default). Iteration-1 suite still passes 23/23 (46/46 combined). Frontend: register → onboarding-skip → 1st profile (Personale, individual) → dashboard (no chip switcher with 1 profile) → +Aggiungi → 2nd profile (Azienda, company) → 2 chips render with default dot on first → clicking Azienda chip updates hero to 'ACME srl' + masked VAT '•• •• •• •• 901' → 'Imposta come identità predefinita' pill appears → clicking it moves default dot to Azienda (toast confirmed) → /card shows both 'Aggiungi a Apple Wallet' and 'Aggiungi a Google Wallet' buttons and neither crashes on click (Linking.openURL) → /share shows 'Identità: Azienda' badge, QR encodes a full /share/{token} URL, public route opens showing correct ACME srl fiscal data. One React Native Web console error surfaced on public share screen ('Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.') visible as toast to user.

ui_bugs.issue: React Native Web console error 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' is emitted and is visible to end users as an error toast (see /tmp/public_share.png bottom-left). Probably an unwrapped whitespace/string next to a component inside a <View>. Search public-share screen for a stray '{something && ...}' or ' ' between JSX children.

issues: Same pre-existing deprecation warnings from iter1 (shadow* props, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver on web). Non-blocking.
HMR-duplicated 'dashboard-view-card' / 'dashboard-edit-profile' DOM nodes on Expo Web dev preview after multiple back/forward navigations. Test harnesses must use .first() — expected by main agent.

action_items: (Optional low priority) Investigate stray text node on the public share screen (/app/frontend/app/share/[token].tsx or similar) — RN Web logs it as an error and it is user-visible as a toast. Likely a stray '{value && '...'}' branch returning a bare string next to Views, or a space/newline expression inside a <View>.
(Nice to have) Ensure toast component filters out RN devtools warnings so console errors don't surface as user-facing toasts.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: profile_to_public() correctly excludes id/label/is_default/_id/user_id — verified end-to-end.
server.py: DELETE /fiscal-profiles/{id} correctly soft-deletes, revokes associated shares (is_active=false), and promotes another profile to default when the deleted one was default — verified.
server.py: POST /shares response now includes profile_id and profile_label; empty body defaults to is_default=true profile (fallback to oldest). Good.
server.py: _wallet_load raises 404 on any decode/lookup failure — proper generic error, no leak.
server.py: Apple .pkpass zip contains required files with SHA-1 manifest; signature is empty by design (documented as MVP preview). This is expected until real Apple cert is plugged in.
server.py: Google Wallet uses HS256 (JWT_SECRET) as a placeholder; Google will reject until service account + RS256 — documented in the 'note' field.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (all specified new-feature flows verified: multi-chip, set-default, wallet buttons, share badge, public share; delete-button visibility not re-verified in second pass because of HMR-duplicated dashboard nodes — but code in /app/frontend/app/fiscal-profile/edit.tsx line 241 correctly renders testID='edit-delete-button' with 'Elimina questa identità' text when id param is present)

seed_data_creation: Registered ephemeral users per test run: multi_a+<ts>@fiskid.it, multi_b+<ts>@fiskid.it (backend pytest) and tester+<ts>@fiskid.it (frontend Playwright). Created two fiscal profiles (Personale/Individual + Azienda/Company) for the Playwright user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite is deterministic when run with -n 0 (serial) because both test modules share module-scoped STATE and use time-based emails. If run under the default xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope with the two modules on separate workers, they still pass because each module has independent state. For frontend testing, always use .first() on 'dashboard-view-card' and 'dashboard-edit-profile' because Expo Web dev HMR duplicates these DOM nodes across navigations. Public share URL pattern remains /share/{token}. Wallet feature is a preview MVP — the note field in wallet-tokens response explicitly says Apple pass is unsigned and Google JWT is placeholder — testing should NOT expect these to actually install on device.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found. Only cosmetic RN Web warning surfacing as toast on public share screen (medium priority).
